sloka: स्थाप्य राज्ये मम सुतम् क्Rत्वा रामम् वने चरम् ।निह्सपत्नाम् च माम् क्Rत्वा क्Rत क्Rत्यो भविष्यसि ॥२-१४-२२॥
transliteration: sthāpya rājye mama sutam kRtvā rāmam vane caram ।nihsapatnām ca mām kRtvā kRta kRtyo bhaviṣyasi ॥2-14-22॥

translations.english: Only after you have installed my son in the kingdom and sent Rama to the forest and made me free from rivals, you shall have your duty fulfiled.
